description: Run a free Tuper Site Check on a public website (measured in a real browser): returns a 0-100 score, counts by severity, the top 5 problems (what, why it matters, where) and the full report URL. Takes 20-90 s. If still running after wait_seconds, returns status "running" and an id for get_report.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the id (0 = do not wait)

name: check_site
title: Check a website
